objective: Determine from the exact frozen V693 outputs whether generalized coherence fails primarily because prompt-derived identifiers are not copied exactly or because complete identifiers are ordered incorrectly.

taxonomy.pass: all three exact evaluator labels occur in the required order
taxonomy.complete_exact_labels_wrong_order: all exact labels occur but not in evaluator order
taxonomy.identifier_stem_absent: at least one exact label is absent and the shared nonce identifier stem never occurs
taxonomy.partial_exact_identifier_copy: the shared nonce identifier stem occurs but at least one complete exact label is absent
taxonomy.surface_loop_suspected: an alphabetic substring of length 3-32 repeats consecutively at least four times

decision_rule: Localize an identifier-copy bottleneck only if at least 80% of adapted failures omit or corrupt an exact prompt-derived identifier, at least 95% of adapted rows containing all three exact labels order them correctly, at least 50 adapted rows contain all exact labels, and all governance/integrity gates pass. That result authorizes only design of one prospective generic prompt-identifier pointer/copy protocol; it does not authorize implementation or candidate construction.
claim_boundary: Frozen-output error attribution protocol only; no repaired architecture, candidate, stable frontier, matched baseline, final test, Phase 4 certificate, or superiority claim.
